prompt: Crea una clase de configuracion con dos RestClient beans nombrados: uno para el servicio de pagos (payments-api) y otro para el servicio de notificaciones (notifications-api). Ambos deben tener base URL desde ConfigurationProperties y timeouts configurados.

assertions.text: All method parameters use the 'final' keyword
Each RestClient bean has an explicit name via @Bean(name = "...") or @Bean("...")
Configuration properties are defined as Java records with @ConfigurationProperties
Both RestClient beans have connect and read timeouts configured
Service class uses @Qualifier to inject the correct named RestClient bean
No hardcoded URLs in the code — all URLs come from ConfigurationProperties
